How we work

How an engagement works

Whichever services you combine, every engagement runs the same way: a scope agreed in writing, delivery against it, regular reviews with your team and a follow-up once the work is done.

  1. Scoping

    • A briefing with your HR and technical leads on the roles, skills and timing you need
    • A written proposal with the deliverables, timeline, team and fees
    • One named consultant as your contact from the first call

  2. Delivery

    • Work starts on the agreed date, against the milestones in the proposal
    • Technical assessment by engineers who know your discipline
    • Written progress updates, with every candidate and finding documented

  3. Governance

    • Measures of success agreed at the start, such as time to shortlist or roles covered
    • Reviews with your decision makers at a fixed cadence
    • A clear escalation path if priorities or timelines change

  4. Follow-up

    • Check-ins with you, and with anyone we placed, in the months after delivery
    • A closing review of the results against the measures agreed at the start
    • Recommendations for the next stage of your talent lifecycle
